environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are mounted. The container's OCI layer is squashfs with dm-verity integrity. Pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default variant) that additionally restricts clock_gettime to CLOCK_MONOTONIC_COARSE granularity via SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO on clock_gettime with CLOCK_MONOTONIC argument. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy applies egress-only rules and the Istio sidecar enforces 50ms fixed-delay fault injection on all responses from this service, configured via VirtualService destinationRule with fixedDelay outlier detection.

config.volumes: none - no emptyDir, no PVC, no hostPath, no projected volumes with writable subpath
config.seccomp_profile: custom profile restricting clock_gettime precision to CLOCK_MONOTONIC_COARSE (~4ms granularity)
config.network_policy: ingress only from istio-proxy sidecar, egress denied
